been a patient at this surgery for over 15 years, and sadly the quality of service has gone downhill badly. My wife’s appointment was cancelled at the very last minute with no apology. We later learned that the nurse had called in sick at short notice, even though we both took time off work to attend.

At her next appointment, we called ahead about being delayed due to a road closure. We were told being 10 minutes late was fine, but when we arrived 12 minutes late, the nurse refused to see her, despite being free and the next patient not yet arrived.  It would have taken no more than five minutes to review her. This showed a complete lack of empathy and flexibility.

Also, when the self check-in machine wasn’t working, she tried to get help at reception and was ignored. Thankfully, one of the long-standing receptionists helped her, but others clearly need proper customer service training.

The new phone system is another disaster: a pre-recorded message that drags on for nearly 2 minutes before you can even get in the queue. It’s no wonder so many patients are now forced to go to urgent care or A&E.

This surgery used to be excellent, but the management and systems have made it unnecessarily complicated and unwelcoming. They really need to fix the way they treat their patients and bring back the standards they once
